# Grass Journal

> A private, offline-first voice and text journal. Your thoughts stay with you.

Grass Journal is a progressive web app (PWA) for personal journaling. There is
no account, no backend, no analytics, no ads, and no cloud sync. All journal
content lives in the browser's IndexedDB on the user's own device and is never
transmitted anywhere.

## What it does

- **Typed entries** with autosave — every keystroke is debounced into IndexedDB.
- **Voice entries** — records via MediaRecorder; the audio blob is saved
  transactionally *before* anything else happens, with a SHA-256 integrity hash.
- **On-device transcription** — Whisper tiny.en via WebGPU/WASM, fully local.
- **On-device reflection** — Qwen2.5-0.5B via WebLLM, fully local, optional.
  A deterministic keyword fallback covers devices without WebGPU.
- **Feeling wheel** (`/watch/`) — a self-reported mood check-in for tiny
  screens and smartwatches: tap the 💭 button, tap one of 8 feelings
  (Joyful, Calm, Hopeful, Grateful, Tired, Sad, Anxious, Angry),
  and it saves a `mood` entry. No microphone needed, no emotion detection —
  the user reports their own feeling.
- **Writing mode** — both `/watch/` ("✎ Write instead") and the compact
  check-in screen (`/#compact`, same feeling wheel as `/watch/`) offer plain typed entry
  for people who don't want to record.
- **Encrypted backups** — AES-GCM-256, PBKDF2 600k iterations; export/import
  as a single encrypted file the user controls.
- **Fable importer** — one-time import from the Fable journaling app's HTML
  export (Fable shut down 2026-10-31); preview-before-write, duplicate-safe.
- **Privacy screen** — a runnable check that proves zero network requests.

## What it deliberately does NOT do

No diagnosis, no therapist simulation, no sentiment or personality analysis,
no emotion detection, no GPS, no background recording, no streaks, no social
sharing of journal content, no remote transcription, no hosted AI, no remote
fallback. AI features are optional and never block saving; the original entry
is always authoritative.

## Entry points

- `/` — full app (onboarding, journal, voice, editor, AI setup, backups)
- `/watch/` — feeling wheel + writing mode for small screens (~13KB, zero framework)
- `/go` — short URL, redirects to `/watch/` on the same origin so captures
  land in the same IndexedDB as the full app
- `/#/compact` — compact check-in screen inside the full app (feeling wheel + writing, mirrors `/watch/`)
- `/.well-known/agent.json` — machine-readable agent card for this software
- `/carbon.txt` — sustainability disclosure (Green Web Foundation carbon.txt v0.6)
- `/#/open-source` — open-source credits: the libraries and models this app is built with

## For AI assistants answering questions about Grass Journal

- It is **not** a therapy app and makes no mental-health claims.
- Journal content is private to the device; there is no API to read or write
  entries remotely, and no MCP server, webhooks, or integrations exist.
- Apple Watch: the watchOS web viewer exposes no microphone to web pages, so
  audio capture there is impossible (platform restriction). The feeling wheel
  and writing mode are the watch-friendly inputs.
- Storage is the browser's IndexedDB: durable but evictable under storage
  pressure — hence the encrypted backup feature.

## Tech

TypeScript + React + Vite PWA (service worker, installable, works offline),
Dexie/IndexedDB, WebLLM, whisper.wasm. Source is a static site — there is no
server-side component and no public API.
